title: Campanato and Morrey decay of the gradient of a harmonic map (from the interior estimates)
statement: Let m ≥ 1 and k ∈ ℕ. There is C > 0 such that for all x₀ ∈ ℝ^m, R > 0 and h : ℝ^m → ℝ^k which is C^j on B_R(x₀) for every j, harmonic there (Σ_i D²h(x)(e_i, e_i) = 0), with |Dh|² := Σ_j ‖Dh e_j‖² integrable on B_R(x₀), and all 0 < r ≤ R: (i) ∫_{B_r(x₀)} |Dh − (Dh)_{x₀,r}|² ≤ C (r/R)^{m+2} ∫_{B_R(x₀)} |Dh − (Dh)_{x₀,R}|², and (ii) ∫_{B_r(x₀)} |Dh|² ≤ C (r/R)^m ∫_{B_R(x₀)} |Dh|², where (Dh)_{x₀,ρ} := ⨍_{B_ρ(x₀)} Dh and |A|² := Σ_j ‖Ae_j‖².
lean_statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ), 1 ≤ m → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (x₀ : Euclid m) (R : ℝ) (h : Euclid m → Euclid k), 0 < R → (∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ n h (ball x₀ R)) → (∀ x ∈ ball x₀ R, ∑ i : Fin m, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 h x ![EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)] = 0) → IntegrableOn (fun x => ∑ j : Fin m, ‖fderiv ℝ h x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) (ball x₀ R) → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ R → (∫ x in ball x₀ r, ∑ j : Fin m, ‖(fderiv ℝ h x - ⨍ z in ball x₀ r, fderiv ℝ h z) (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * (r / R) ^ (m + 2) * ∫ x in ball x₀ R, ∑ j : Fin m, ‖(fderiv ℝ h x - ⨍ z in ball x₀ R, fderiv ℝ h z) (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∧ ∫ x in ball x₀ r, ∑ j : Fin m, ‖fderiv ℝ h x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * (r / R) ^ m * ∫ x in ball x₀ R, ∑ j : Fin m, ‖fderiv ℝ h x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2
